hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Levies a flat 1% protocol fee in native ETH on every swap of a native-ETH/token pool, using BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta to take the fee via PoolManager custom accounting. Fees are split between a treasury (10% default, up to 40% max) and a per-pool creator address (minimum 60%), accrued in-contract and withdrawn on demand.
